output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, C&S’s most recent corporate description identifies these companies in its family of companies: Grocers Supply, Hansen Distribution Group, The Davidson Specialty Food Group, and SpartanNash. C&S’s current careers page and a prior company release also identify FreshKo Produce Services as part of the C&S family; the 2015 release specifically called FreshKO a wholly owned subsidiary. The Winn-Dixie Company should not yet be treated as a C&S subsidiary: C&S announced in August 2026 that its proposed majority-ownership transaction was expected to close in early 2027.
caveats: C&S publicly describes these as its “family of companies,” not as a complete legal-entity subsidiary schedule; a definitive list of every legal subsidiary was not verified from an opened public filing.

FreshKo appears in C&S’s current careers/about-us description and was explicitly called wholly owned in 2015, but it is omitted from the August 2026 dated corporate description; its present legal status is therefore less certain than the four companies named in that latest dated release.
The Winn-Dixie transaction was described as proposed and expected to close in early 2027, so Winn-Dixie is not included as a completed subsidiary as of the requested date.
